description: This file contains functions and logic to generate bar chart visualizations using the pChart library within the TestLink project. It defines the createChart() function responsible for setting up chart configurations, preparing data, and rendering the chart image.

classes.name: pChart
classes.description: Class from the pChart library used for drawing charts.

classes.name: pData
classes.description: Class from the pChart library for managing data sets for charts.

methods.name: createChart
methods.description: Generates a stacked bar chart using provided data and configuration parameters. Sets up chart appearance, populates data, and renders the chart image.
